chapter: Forming the band in New York
title: Ace Harris and 'After Hours'
summary: Ace Harris followed Avery Parrish at piano, and Hawkins taught him 'After Hours'.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: And Joe Murphy, the drums. He was, he joined me after Ace Harris was with me. Ace Harris, pianist? Ace Harris followed Avery Parrish. Avery went out on his own.
Ace Harris followed him. I just took Ace Harris up to my apartment and played a record of "After Hours". I said if you play piano good, you've got to play "After Hours" because
that's one of the first tunes that people ask for in the theater.
So, that tune wasn't down on paper cause that was taken from the head of Avery Parrish. So, he played it, and he played it more like Avery than anybody I've heard play it.
